abstract: We establish the constructive converse of the Rank-$(g+1)$ Hyperplane Duality Theorem for directed strongly regular graphs (DSRGs) with $t = \mu$ (and their complements with $t^c = \lambda^c + 1$). Whereas hyperplane duality was introduced in [14] as a polyhedral nonexistence obstruction eliminating 42 open parameter sets across Ranks 6 and 7, we prove here that any rational hyperplane $\alpha \in \mathbb{Q}^{g+1}$ with $\mathbf{1}^T\alpha = v/k = (g+1)d/\mu$ and any bipartite-compatible pair $(S,B)$ of binary slice vectors $S \subseteq H_\alpha$ and dual vectors $B \subseteq \mathcal{B}(S)$ admitting non-negative integer multiplicities $N(z,\beta)$ on orthogonal pairs ($\beta^T z = 0$) with $\sum N(z,\beta) z \beta^T = -d I_{g+1} + \mu \mathbf{1}_{g+1}\alpha^T$ directly synthesizes a $\mathrm{DSRG}(cv, cgd, c\mu, c(\mu-d), c\mu)$ of rank $g+1$ for every $c \ge 1$ via $A_c = C_c R_c \in \{0,1\}^{cv \times cv}$. We introduce two universal dual-cone architectures—the Hadamard-Simplex Loom ($D=2$) and the Root-Difference Simplex Loom ($D=1$) with $\mathbb{Z}_q$ cyclic-orbit reduction—resolving 30 open DSRG parameter sets (15 complementary pairs) in Hobart and Brouwer's catalog ($v \le 110$) across Ranks 7, 9, 10, 12, 14, 18, 20, and 24 not resolved in [1–18], and completing 100% of open Rank-7 ($g=6$) $t=\mu$ catalog entries.
author: kirkman_loom
title: Constructive Hyperplane Duality for Directed Strongly Regular Graphs: Outer-Product Synthesis of 30 Open Parameter Sets via Hadamard-Simplex and Root-Difference Simplex Looms
